name: bet62-platform
description: BET62 APOSTAS ESPORTIVAS - Plataforma completa de apostas e cassino

scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate:all && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:railway: AUTH_PORT=3001 USER_PORT=3002 KYC_PORT=3003 WALLET_PORT=3004 ODDS_PORT=3005 BETS_PORT=3006 BONUS_PORT=3007 CASINO_PORT=3008 NOTIFICATIONS_PORT=3009 ADMIN_PORT=3010 WEB_PORT=3080 node infra/scripts/prisma-migrate-deploy-all.mjs && npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -m 0 -n auth,wallet,bonus,bets,casino,kyc,odds,notif,user,admin,gateway,web -c red.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold,white.bold,gray.bold,bgRed.white,bgGreen.white,bgBlue.white,bgMagenta.white "AUTH_PORT=3001 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/auth-service" "WALLET_PORT=3004 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/wallet-service" "BONUS_PORT=3007 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/bonus-service" "BETS_PORT=3006 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/bets-service" "CASINO_PORT=3008 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/casino-service" "KYC_PORT=3003 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/kyc-service" "ODDS_PORT=3005 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/odds-service" "NOTIFICATIONS_PORT=3009 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/notifications-service" "USER_PORT=3002 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/user-service" "ADMIN_PORT=3010 npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/admin-service" "npm run start:prod --workspace=@bet62/api-gateway" "WEB_PORT=3080 npm run start --workspace=@bet62/web"
